description: The length on the wire as a float32 (card boost-near-the-minimum-length-the-client-predicts-a-base-ste), against the g1b-stand-in baselines, measured on another machine (reaper1): the tick's p95 is about twice the baselines' everywhere, 0.17-0.24 ms against 0.08-0.11, and the shipped code (6495269) measures 0.19 ms on it too, so the tick floor is 0.2 ms. control-0ms ownVsRemotePx p95 (20.5 to 26.9 px) is within the run spread of the shipped code on the same machine (23.6 px, spread 4.1), so its floor is 7 px. The others restate g1b-stand-in's, since this file replaces the whole absoluteFloor map. Use it for this card's runs against the g1b-stand-in baselines only.
